description: Compatibility definitions for dyeing project details.

details.description: Saved details of older dyeing projects.

projectType.description: Optional category for what was dyed. Choose Other when no listed category fits. Use materialForm for older records when projectType is absent.

projectSubtype.description: Optional item name within the selected project type. Store a known subtype identifier or a short author-supplied name. Custom names may be used with Other or any listed type.

materialForm.description: Deprecated: form of the material when it was dyed. Use the project description for new posts.

dyeType.description: Deprecated: type of dye used. Use the project description or hashtags for new posts.

applicationMethod.description: Deprecated: how the dye was applied to the material. Use the project description or hashtags for new posts.

colorEffect.description: Deprecated: colour effect in the dyed material. Use the project description or hashtags for new posts.

recipeNotes.description: Deprecated: optional notes about the dyeing recipe or process. Use the project description for new posts.

spunYarn.description: Yarn that was spun before dyeing.

kettleDyed.description: Dyed in a kettle or dye bath.

handPainted.description: Dye applied to selected areas by hand.

dipDyed.description: Dyed by dipping part or all of the material.

semiSolid.description: A mostly consistent colour with subtle variation.

selfStriping.description: Colour sections arranged to produce stripes as the yarn is worked.
